# castai_external_connection_permissions (Data Source)

Computes the IAM permissions and Kubernetes RBAC rules required for a given cloud provider, connection scope, and feature selection. This is a pure compute operation with no side effects — useful for previewing the permissions needed before provisioning.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) The cloud provider to compute permissions for. Valid values: AWS, AZURE, GCP, ORACLE.
- `features` (Block List, Min: 1) The features to compute permissions for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--features))

### Optional

- `connection_scope` (String) Whether to include organization-level grants. Defaults to ORGANIZATION when unspecified — set to ACCOUNT to opt out of org-level grants. Valid values: AWS_ACCOUNT, AWS_ORGANIZATION, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION, GCP_ORGANIZATION, GCP_PROJECT.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kubernetes_components` (List of Object) Kubernetes components and their RBAC rules to grant in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubernetes_components))
- `permissions` (List of Object) Cloud IAM permissions the customer must grant in their cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedblock--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Required:

- `feature` (String) The feature type. Valid values: CLOUD_CONNECT, COST_MONITORING, NODE_AUTOSCALING, WORKLOAD_AUTOSCALING, KARPENTER_ENTERPRISE, STORAGE_OPTIMIZATION, POD_MUTATIONS, APA, DBO, OMNI, KIMCHI.

Optional:

- `registry_version` (String) Registry version to pin for this feature. When set, permissions are computed for that version's snapshot. When unset, the latest version is used.
- `sub_features` (List of String) Sub-features to include. Empty means base permissions only.
